title: moduleWrites
responsibility: Preflight all module outputs and roll back task-owned writes when a write fails.

inputs.name: writeModuleFiles.root
inputs.description: Absolute project directory containing the package manifest and module metadata.

inputs.name: writeModuleFiles.files
inputs.description: Complete relative-path file plan, checked before any write.

inputs.name: writeModuleFiles.replace
inputs.description: Explicit metadata paths this transaction is permitted to update.

inputs.name: writeModuleFiles.allowIdentical
inputs.description: Whether an existing byte-identical file is an idempotent setup output.

inputs.name: moduleOutputPath.path
inputs.description: Relative module output path that must stay within supported project code areas.

outputs.name: writeModuleFiles
outputs.description: Relative paths actually created or updated by this operation.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid definitions, incompatible project settings, unsafe paths or conflicting source files prevent the operation.
